title: W1 MATERIAL HISTORY RULES

implementationResponsibilities.capture: producer / initial prospective allocator implementation location

directionEvidence.standing: approves finalisation direction, NOT this exact publication

statusRule: Controlled specification on competent Owner-authorised verified publication; candidate before that event
effectivityRule: Effective for W1 DEVELOPMENT / CONFORMANCE at the verified Owner-authorised atomic publication revision; no invented date or containing hash
operationalApplicability: NOT established by publication; exact real format, issuer/allocator, principal/grant, policy and deployment applicability required before corresponding real use
implementationAuthorisation: NONE conveyed by this specification or its publication
relationships: retain exact input/output and prior/new correction values; activity retry does not create independent material event; current projection does not overwrite history
checkpoint: atomically bind subject/context/incarnation/order/state and material activity reference; acknowledge only declared storage state; no persisted claim from memory-only acceptance
recovery: verify stored subject and exact historical dependency set; new activity/new incarnation; explicit eligibility required; unknown old binding stays LEGACY ASSURANCE GAP
authorityProof: principal snapshot signature is not grant authority; separate competent grant decision and complete scoped control-plane bundle required
privacy: necessary/permissible retained context and relationships only; payload retention not perpetual; policy periods/legal bases/permissions not invented
acceptance: material provenance, operational use and observer conformance do not confer canonical Event acceptance

perActivityEligibility.activation: competent subject/domain/capability/effectivity grant plus explicit baseline and eligible incarnation
perActivityEligibility.advance: applicable advance capability and monotonic-live baseline; observations alone cannot prove historical continuity
perActivityEligibility.correction: correct capability; attributable prior/new values and basis
perActivityEligibility.periodTransition: period-transition capability; exact format and known boundary
perActivityEligibility.checkpoint: checkpoint capability; atomic subject/context/state/history and declared acknowledgement level
perActivityEligibility.recovery: recover capability plus explicit restart eligibility and new incarnation/activity; qualified reconstruction

materialRelationships: Preserve exact activity inputs, outputs, source actor/process/build and governed historical dependencies, including series membership/head-selection where material. Tick observations reference the current material baseline; no universal event-sourcing mandate.
stateAssurance: Missing transition proof is a scoped authority/history gap even if snapshot emission is permitted. Observer may retain a historical qualified claim but cannot promote it to eligible progress.
